description: Explicit decisions for specialized theme near-color pairs. Keep this file in sync with scripts/audit-theme-colors.mjs output; lower the audit baseline when a pair is merged.

decisions.reason: Tokyo Night structural chrome uses the canonical Tokyo base hue around storm-indigo content; #1c1c1f is the default dark/china/slate neutral surface. Merging would flatten cross-theme identity rather than remove an app-level duplicate.
decisions.reevaluateWhen: Only after a visual review proves Tokyo Night no longer needs a distinct structural chrome identity.

decisions.reason: Midnight content, raised panels, and editor lineHighlight are adjacent in the same dark theme. Merging would weaken surface and editor-row separation.
decisions.reevaluateWhen: Only after a Midnight surface-ramp redesign removes the adjacent role split.

decisions.reason: The first value is the light xterm blue and the second is the light workbench link hover. They belong to different renderer and document interaction semantics.
decisions.reevaluateWhen: Reevaluate only when terminal ANSI and workbench link roles share a reviewed palette contract.

decisions.reason: LivingLine preview uses slightly different translucent white surfaces for stage background and control borders; merging would reduce depth separation in the debug preview.
decisions.reevaluateWhen: Only after a LivingLine preview visual review removes the need for distinct translucent surfaces.

decisions.reason: LivingLine preview uses slightly different translucent white borders for cards and controls; merging would reduce edge separation in the debug preview.
decisions.reevaluateWhen: Only after a LivingLine preview visual review removes the need for distinct translucent borders.
